basic_info.description: Built in 1922, this west facing home beautifully balances original period details with modern updates. The formal floor plan unfolds with a light-filled living room featuring a decorative fireplace, and an elegant dining room. The kitchen includes a an induction cooktop, and a convenient pantry. Two comfortable bedrooms and a split bathroom complete the main living space, a versatile sunroom serves perfectly as either a home office 3rd bedroom. Architect plans are included to transform the current bathroom into two full baths. Recent upgrades: new roof, HVAC system, fresh interior and exterior paint, and designer light fixtures. The owners transformed the backyard into a private oasis, with a serene pond and native plants that create a natural habitat. This outdoor space offers endless possibilities for entertaining, gardening, and play. A large garage provides laundry, workshop potential, and abundant storage space. Close to GG Park and directly across from a welcoming school playground that's open on weekends for community use and hosts popular Music Together classes. Enjoy the Balboa shops, restaurants, and bakeries. With easy access to schools, public transit, and Ocean Beach just minutes away, this location is perfect!
